name: PF Config
description: Settings for the Participant follow-up workflows. Mode from the instance: production = pilot (pilotHostEmails only), staging = mock. DWN-6.

parameters.content:
## PF Config
All settings for the Participant follow-up workflows. Other PF workflows call this one and read the result. Change values only in **Build Config**.

The mode comes from the instance:
- **production** (`darwin-production`): `pilot`. Real participants, real timings, only hosts in `pilotHostEmails`. Empty list = all hosts (release).
- **staging / unknown**: `mock`. Emails only to aniol.moner+*@n8n.io, DMs only to Aniol, short timings, `[MOCK]` tag, Tremendous stub.

**Manual Test Run** also shows `simulated_production`.
